id: title:jurajmajerik:handle deleted experiment in exposures query runner

observations.behavior: Replaces direct database lookup with a try/except block to catch Experiment.DoesNotExist and raise a ValidationError instead.
observations.code_quote: raise ValidationError(f"Experiment with id {self.query.experiment_id} not found")
observations.posthog_connection: This prevents uncaught database exceptions when an exposure query references a non-existent experiment ID, potentially caused by stale cached queries or deleted experiments, and returns a clear validation error to the caller.
